basic_details.job_title: Department of Pharmaceuticals Technical Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Department of Pharmaceuticals has announced 5 vacancies for Technical Consultant - Grade 1 and Technical Consultant - Grade 2 posts on a contract basis under advertisement number 05/2026. Eligible candidates must apply through the prescribed offline application process, sending the completed form by speed post, hand-delivery in a sealed cover to Under Secretary (Policy), Department of Pharmaceuticals, Room No. 22020, 2nd floor, Kartavya Bhawan-II, or by email on or before 11 November 2026. content_sections.heading: About DoP Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The Department of Pharmaceuticals, under the Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers, is implementing the Bio-pharma SHAKTI Scheme. These contractual positions are for the Project Management Unit (PMU) to provide technical and programme support for the scheme's implementation.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted using the prescribed form. Candidates may choose one of the following two methods: 1. By Hard Copy: Sent via Speed Post or hand-delivered in a sealed cover to: Office of Under Secretary (Policy), Department of Pharmaceuticals, Room No. 22020, 2nd floor, Kartavya Bhawan-II, New Delhi. Addressed to: Under Secretary (Policy), Department of Pharmaceuticals, 22020, 2nd floor, Kartavya Bhawan-II, New Delhi (During working hours on a working day). 2. content_sections.heading: DoP Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Assist in preparations of RFAs - for Implementation of the Scheme write component-wise RFAs, getting it approved by competent authority and publish it. Plan and undertake outreach activities include roadshows, webinars, social media post, etc. Conduct desk reviews of applications as required; review screening and parameter-based scoring; prepare technical appraisal notes and recommendations for TC/PAAC. Get assessment of scientific merit, novelty/FTO (basic), feasibility, team competency, development risks, and alignment to RPFs of Biopharma Shakti. Prepare tangible milestones as per the approved proposal for assigned projects. Ensure alignment with applicable regulatory, GFR and quality frameworks, and other domestic or international standards governing clinical, and ethical practices, and confirm that the supporting documentation is complete, current, and sufficient for evaluation. Review project plans for cost rationality, resource realism, co-funding evidence, and adherence to scheme expenditure guardrails; suggest re-phasing where required. Execute Agreement – Prepare and execute Grant agreement with legal vetting. Review progress reports; examine extension/variance and over/under-utilisation requests; recommend milestone disbursals/withholds. Undertake site/virtual visits and third-party validations as advised, file visit reports and non-conformance notes. Work with PMA, TC and empanelled experts for assignments, Relevant disclosure checks, and consolidation of reviews; maintain decision trails and audit ready records. Contribute to SOPs/templates, reviewer manuals, milestone descriptor catalogue, and portal/MIS field refinements. Support onboarding/orientation of reviewers; provide clarifications on technical queries from DoP/TC/PMA. Be responsible for implementation of one or more components of Scheme. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The Department of Pharmaceuticals invites applications for engagement of five (05) Technical Consultants (02 of Grade-1 and 03 of Grade-2) for providing Technical and Programme Support for Implementation of the Bio-pharma SHAKTI Scheme.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Last Date for Receipt of Application: [11.11.2026].

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Post-Graduate degree (M. Pharm/M.Sc./M. Tech.) in Pharmaceutical Sciences / Medicinal Chemistry / Pharmacology / Biotech or related field; or equivalent qualification with strong relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What are the age limits for Grade 1 and Grade 2 consultants?
faq.answer: Maximum age limit should not be more than 40 years as on 31.03.2026 for Grade 1, and not be more than 50 years as on 31.03.2026 for Grade 2.

faq.question: Q5. How can I submit my application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted using the prescribed form. Completed applications should reach the Department on or before the specified last date. Submissions are accepted via either of the following methods: By Hard Copy or By Email.

faq.question: Q6. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: Tenure is 1 fixed year + 4 years, extendable subject to satisfactory performance. The position is that of a consultant and nothing in the contract engaging consultant will establish, constitute or imply the relationship of employer and employee, or of a principal and its agent, between this Department and consultant.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary range for these positions?
faq.answer: Remuneration (fixed) shall be in the range of ₹80,000 to ₹1,45,000 per month for Grade 1, and ₹1,45,000 to ₹2,65,000 per month for Grade 2, with an annual increment of 5%, subject to performance review.
